description: This file provides biometric authentication services for the Notesnook app, including fingerprint sensor availability, credential storage, user validation, and related utilities.

methods.name: isBiometryAvailable
methods.description: Checks if biometric sensor (fingerprint) is available on the device.

methods.name: enableFingerprintAuth
methods.description: Enables fingerprint authentication by setting a flag in storage.

methods.name: isFingerprintAuthEnabled
methods.description: Checks if fingerprint authentication is enabled.

methods.name: storeCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials securely in the keychain.

methods.name: resetCredentials
methods.description: Resets/deletes stored credentials from the keychain.

methods.name: hasInternetCredentials
methods.description: Checks if internet credentials are stored in the keychain.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Performs biometric authentication and retrieves stored credentials.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Performs biometric authentication to validate user identity.
